title: Approving a spec can land it (opt-in)
summary: With proposals.approveLands on, an approval also lands the spec PR once every check is green: one polled path for both forges, pinned to the approved head, as the approver.

add.label: lander.js
add.desc: Landing on approval: polls an approved spec PR and lands it with Land it's merge once it is mergeable and green; stops on a push, a red check, a closed PR, a lost sign-in or the time.

set.desc: The one place a review is checked and posted; after an approval it starts a landing in the background when the config asks for one.

change.why: the one hook point of landing on approval

set.desc: Land a green pull request and the pipeline's steps; landPull is the one merge path Land it and landing on approval share.

change.why: landPull is shared with the lander

set.desc: The SQLite file in the data folder (node:sqlite): sessions, reviews, the audit of actions, forge answers, hook memory, review tokens and pending landings.

change.why: a landings table, so a restart resumes a pending landing

scenarios.title: A maintainer approves a spec and it lands with no second click

steps.text: The approval is posted as a review comment; the response goes back at once.
A landing is remembered (a row) and the spec PR is looked at: closed, moved on to another head, red, still running, or green.
The row survives a restart, and the landing is picked up again when cornfield starts.
Green and mergeable: the same merge as Land it, pinned to the approved head, as the approver, and the pr.landed hook.
A push, a red check or a lost sign-in leaves the PR open and says so once on the PR.
